segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Standard handover; wet ground was described as more seepage than usual but not alarming on its own, and the blast, mucking, and haulage plan was stated.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is initial situational assessment and plan description. It does not independently manifest the hidden post-hoc causal-chain instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I authorized the blast after a visual pass and did not call for an instrumented convergence check because the event was small and classified as normal range.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A substantive blast decision and rationale, but not the hidden Narrative Fallacy mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The microseismic cluster was increasing in frequency rather than magnitude; ventilation was normal, so haulage continued as-is.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a distinct operational continuation decision. The hidden manifest assigns no bias instance to this episode.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The brief methane spike returned to baseline; it was logged as transient with no recurrence and was not considered significant at the time.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification introduces this as a neutral phase-2 signal. It becomes bias-relevant only through its later treatment in the post-FOG explanation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: post-FOG causal explanation and discordant-cue dismissal
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The seismic event, wet ground, adjacent-panel cluster, and blast vibration 'all lined up'; the participant formed a stress-transfer explanation, said it made sense, and then set aside the methane spike because it did not fit and was not investigated.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is the sole hidden instance: a fluent, seemingly complete post-hoc causal chain linking disparate signals into an expected-looking explanation for the FOG while excluding the discordant methane reading without genuine follow-up.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant considered visual-only, instrumented inspection, and reduced-charge options; the seismic classification carried the most weight and wet ground created only limited uncertainty.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This elaborates the blast decision and contains no independent hidden occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant considered rerouting or halting, relied on ventilation readings, and did not call the on-call geotechnical engineer because the cluster did not seem urgent enough.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a follow-up rationale for the phase-2 haulage decision; the hidden specification does not assign an instance here.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant acknowledged an undetermined-cause investigation and real-time engineering input as alternatives, but chose the stress-transfer account and direct re-support; later described why the explanation felt solid and why the methane spike did not fit.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an adjacent elaboration of the same decision-point episode. The single hidden instance is localized to seg_005, where the full chain construction and dismissal are expressed together; these later probes do not create a second occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: production resumption and retrospective evidence review
segments.raw_interview_anchor: After re-support, full production resumed; the participant later acknowledged that engineering review and alternative explanations were still needed before the cause could be considered definitive.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification explicitly prevents phase-4 resumption and later engineering review from being treated as a new independent Narrative Fallacy occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: A repeated methane spike would have been harder to dismiss; the participant said the stress-transfer story might not have been the whole cause and that the pieces fit well enough that he did not push hard on what did not fit.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: These are retrospective and counterfactual reflections on the same episode, not a second independently identifiable manifestation.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Post-fall-of-ground causal explanation and re-support decision at decision point 3
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Post-hoc construction of a single fluent causal chain linking the overnight seismic event, wet ground, adjacent-panel cluster, and blast vibration into a seemingly complete explanation for the FOG, while dismissing the discordant methane spike without genuine investigation.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Confirmation bias is a near-neighbor construct: it explains discounting the methane spike because it did not fit the preferred account, but it is not an approved equivalent name for Narrative Fallacy. The RAG label therefore cannot earn a strict match.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the full operational mechanism: after the FOG, disparate prior signals were assembled into one coherent causal account, confidence increased because the timing/location/mechanism appeared to fit, and the discordant methane reading was set aside without follow-up. Its confirmation-bias framing is a taxonomy difference rather than a missing mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted interview evidence is valid, directly attributed to the Participant, and substantively supports the localized episode. The later engineering alternatives are correctly treated as counterevidence after the decision rather than as a new occurrence.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly localized to the blast decision, but anchoring on the minor seismic classification is a different construct from the hidden post-hoc causal-chain explanation at the FOG.

The finding concerns continuing haulage during the phase-2 cluster, whereas the hidden instance concerns post-hoc explanation construction after the FOG. Schedule pressure and nearby evidence do not make the constructs equivalent.

The candidate concerns confidence exceeding evidential warrant, but it does not itself capture the full hidden causal-chain mechanism and it overlaps the already matched confirmation-bias/Narrative-Fallacy claim in the same episode.
The candidate concerns normalization of a single transient methane reading in phase 2. That reading is neutral at introduction and is not the full post-hoc causal-chain mechanism assigned to phase 3.

The candidate speculates that remembered prior settling episodes influenced the phase-2 haulage decision. The interview does not establish availability-driven judgment, and the episode is outside the hidden instance.

candidates.details: The confidence language is real and relevant, but the candidate lacks an objective calibration target and is not separable from the already matched causal-explanation claim.
The output appropriately notes that a single transient reading can reflect ordinary diagnostic noise and that the candidate is difficult to separate from the later identified mechanism.
The output explicitly withholds identification because the transcript does not distinguish recall fluency from legitimate domain experience.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Blast-stage anchoring does not reproduce the hidden post-hoc causal-chain mechanism.

The finding fully captures the causal-chain construction and dismissal of the discordant methane cue, but uses a non-equivalent label.
Confidence language overlaps the episode but does not independently establish the hidden mechanism.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: No change: no moderate-confidence findings were supplied.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding two low-confidence findings adds two instance-level false positives and two segment-level false alarms, while recall remains complete under the mechanism-first scorecard.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding three candidates adds three instance-level false positives, including one duplicate, and two additional segment-level false alarms; no candidate becomes a true positive.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: The run detects the sole biased segment at every threshold, but broadening beyond high confidence raises false alarms from 0 to 2, and including candidates raises them to 4.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance identification is 0.0000 F1 at every threshold because the RAG never names Narrative Fallacy or an approved equivalent; its high-confidence confirmation-bias finding is correctly located but has the wrong label.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first identification is perfect at high-only and high-and-moderate because the high-confidence confirmation-bias finding fully captures the hidden mechanism; F1 falls to 0.5000 with low-confidence findings and 0.2857 when candidates are included.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidates add calibrated diagnostic context, especially by withholding normalcy and availability as definitive findings, but none becomes a true positive and their inclusion materially increases false alarms.
main_failure_modes: The RAG's strongest finding uses a near-neighbor label rather than the hidden target label, producing a strict taxonomy failure.
Two low-confidence identified findings are unrelated to the hidden occurrence and create false positives when included.
Candidate inclusion adds a duplicate overconfidence hypothesis and two further unsupported detections at the fourth threshold.
main_strengths: The high-confidence finding localizes to the correct decision episode with valid, directly supporting quotations.
Its stated mechanism captures the hidden causal-chain construction and dismissal of the discordant methane signal.
The output distinguishes identified findings from cautious candidates and explicitly records evidence limitations.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This is a strong mechanism-sensitive but taxonomy-imperfect run. It would appear to fail completely under strict label matching while correctly detecting the intended reasoning distortion under the mechanism-first scorecard. The recommended comparison threshold remains high_and_moderate because it avoids speculative low-confidence and candidate detections.
